_comment: Globnetics Immutable SemVer Release Tags: Protects all Git tags (~ALL). Enforces strict semantic versioning format (e.g., v1.0.0, v2.1.3-beta.1), and prevents deleting, updating, or moving existing release tags. Protects package consumers against supply-chain tampering.
name: Globnetics - Immutable SemVer Release Tags

parameters.name: Semantic Versioning format (e.g., v1.2.3 or v1.2.3-alpha.1)
